messages:
maria-cs: Hey team — customer hit a validation error when using tool calling. Error: structured_output_validation_failed. Request ID: req_0a1b2c3d. Happened ~2026-11-12 15:22 UTC. They included a function schema and got a 400. Posting snippets below.

sam-support: Thanks @maria-cs — can you get the full request_id, a curl that reproduces, and a debug bundle? Also we need model & route. Small repro is fine.

maria-cs: Request ID: req_0a1b2c3d. Model: redwood-open-v1. Route: /v1/chat/completions. Customer payload (redacted):
```json
{
  "model": "redwood-open-v1",
  "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"Convert to JSON"}],
  "function_call": {"name":"create_invoice"},
  "functions": [{"name":"create_invoice","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"amount":{"type":"string"}}}}]
}
```

lee-eng-runtime: That function schema looks suspicious — amount is string but customer might be sending a number. Also function_call is usually either "auto" or omitted; forcing a name is fine but confirm payload. Can you paste the exact error from the API logs (stacktrace + validation message)?

maria-cs: Error from API:
```
400 Bad Request
{
  "error": {
    "type": "structured_output_validation_failed",
    "message": "choices[0].tool_call.arguments did not match schema: /amount: expected string but got number",
    "request_id": "req_0a1b2c3d"
  }
}
```

sam-support: Please try this curl against the customer's payload (replace $API_KEY & endpoint) and paste output. Use --compressed to keep it small.
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d @payload.json
```

lee-eng-runtime: For fast triage, here's a minimal repro payload we used locally. Try it and share raw request/response if you can.
```json
{
  "model": "redwood-open-v1",
  "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"Make invoice for 12.50"}],
  "functions": [{"name":"create_invoice","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"amount":{"type":"number"}}}}],
  "function_call": {"name":"create_invoice"}
}
```

ivan-ml: If the model returns a tool_call.arguments string with an unquoted number, our JSON parser might coerce it to a number vs string. We should check the token stream. Can you include the raw tokenized output from the debug bundle?

maria-cs: Upload link for debug bundle: https://redwood-internal/uploads/req_0a1b2c3d (customer approved). Time window: 2026-11-12T15:20:00Z - 2026-11-12T15:25:00Z

ops-bot: debug-bundle collected (id db_4432). Size: 2.3MB. Use internal tool `rb-debug` to fetch: `rb-debug fetch db_4432 --redact`.

lee-eng-runtime: I'll pull the bundle now. Quick checklist for me: include original function schema, exact response body (choices[0].tool_call.arguments), tokenized output, and the request/response headers. If you can paste the customer's curl that triggered it, that helps.

sam-support: Assigned to @lee-eng-runtime and @ivan-ml. I'll keep the customer updated. :thumbsup:

maria-cs: Customer also noted p95 latency spikes on these calls (usually ~1.2s -> 2.8s) — that is captured in the bundle.

lee-eng-runtime: Noted. I'll triage schema mismatch first, then look at latency. Will post findings here.

ivan-ml: If we confirm a parser bug, short-term workaround: change the schema to accept both string and number using a oneOf: [{"type":"string"},{"type":"number"}]. Please advise customer.

sam-support: Thanks — please post repro curl + final root cause when you have it.

lee-eng-runtime: Pulling bundle and running local repro now. Will update by EOD UTC.
